fact: 1933年3月6日（就职后两天）罗斯福宣布全国银行假日（bank holiday），关闭所有银行并冻结黄金交易；3月9日《紧急银行法》在约八小时内通过，授权财政部审查并重新开业稳健银行。

sources.title: "Action, and Action Now" FDR's First 100 Days（FDR Library & Museum）
sources.quote: Based on this opinion and on emergency, decided on Proclamation declaring banking holiday from tonight through Thursday, March ninth.

sources.title: Emergency Banking Act of 1933（Federal Reserve History）
sources.quote: Signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt on March 9, 1933, the legislation was aimed at restoring public confidence in the nation's financial system after a weeklong bank holiday.

fact: 1933年3月12日罗斯福首次「炉边谈话」，通过广播解释银行重新开业；3月13日12家联邦储备城市银行重开，3月14日约250个有清算所的城市重开，3月15日全国稳健银行全部重开。

sources.title: Emergency Banking Act of 1933（Federal Reserve History 美联储历史）
sources.quote: In that Fireside Chat, Roosevelt announced that the next day, March 13, banks in the twelve Federal Reserve Bank cities would reopen. Then, on March 14, banks in cities with recognized clearing houses (about 250 cities) would reopen. On March 15, banks throughout the country that government examiners ensured were sound would reopen and resume business.

sources.title: Fireside Chat: Banking Crisis（FDR Presidential Library & Museum 罗斯福总统图书馆）
sources.quote: The healthy banks were authorized to reopen on March 13. But would people trust them? On March 12, Roosevelt gave the first Fireside Chat.

fact: 1933年4月5日罗斯福签署第6102号行政命令，禁止私人持有超过5盎司黄金、禁止黄金出口，实际放弃金本位；6月5日国会通过废除黄金条款，公私债务不再以黄金支付。

sources.title: New Deal: le misure di Roosevelt contro la Grande Depressione（Fatti per la Storia）
sources.quote: Il 5 aprile 1933, tramite un ordine esecutivo, il presidente emanò l'Ordine Esecutivo 6102, con cui si vietava il possesso d'oro, oltre le 5 once.

sources.title: "Action, and Action Now" FDR's First 100 Days（FDR Library）
sources.quote: April 19 Abandonment of the Gold Standard.

fact: 1933年6月《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法》（即1933年银行法）将商业银行与投资银行业务分离，并设立联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）对个人存款提供保险，结束银行挤兑时代。

sources.title: 1930–1939（FDIC 联邦存款保险公司历史）
sources.quote: March 12, 1933 President Franklin D. Roosevelt gives his first Fireside Chat on the radio. The subject is banking.

sources.title: 美国历史系列98：格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法（ShareAmerica 美国国务院）
sources.quote: 国会通过了'1933年银行法'（Banking Act of 1933），又称'格拉斯–斯蒂格尔法'，将商业银行与投资银行分开，并设立联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）为民众的存款担保。

fact: 1933年美国大萧条达到谷底：失业率约25%，农场收入较1929年暴跌约60%；银行假日期间所有银行关闭，存款无法提取。

sources.title: "Action, and Action Now" FDR's First 100 Days（FDR Library）

fact: 1933年5月设立田纳西河流域管理局（TVA），在七个州建设水坝、发电与防洪工程，为农村提供廉价电力；同时通过《农业调整法》（AAA）补贴农民减产以提高农产品价格。

sources.title: "Action, and Action Now" FDR's First 100 Days（FDR Library）

fact: 紧急银行法授权财政部审查银行资产、提供所需资本并判定哪些银行适合重开；新政通过公共工程、农业补贴与电力项目创造就业，TVA、CCC（民间资源保护队）与WPA后续成为政府雇佣的主要渠道。

sources.title: Emergency Banking Act of 1933（Federal Reserve History 美联储历史）
sources.quote: The Act gave the government authority to examine bank finances, provide needed capital, and determine which banks were fit to reopen.

sources.title: Fireside Chat: Banking Crisis（FDR Presidential Library & Museum）
sources.quote: Rushed to Congress four days later, it was approved within hours. The Act gave the government authority to examine bank finances, provide needed capital, and determine which banks were fit to reopen.

fact: 银行假日期间全国银行关闭，储户无法提取存款；首次炉边谈话后，公众信心逐步恢复，更多存款回流银行。这是美国历史上第一次系统性的金融紧急状态。
